name: Illes Foods
old_description: From marinades and seasonings, to beverage solutions and sauces, ILLES Foods provides custom-crafted culinary creations and R&D expertise to foodservice chains, food manufacturers, and grocery retailers.
about:
Illes Foods operates from Carrollton, Texas. The company traces its roots back 97 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company specializes in custom flavor creations and culinary insights, offering seasonings, sauces, marinades, beverages, and custom flavor development. It provides a full range of manufacturing services for both liquid and dry products, including packaging and labeling. The facility's size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Illes Foods serves foodservice chains, food manufacturers, and grocery retailers. Its customer base includes R&D directors, product development managers, culinary innovation heads, and supply chain executives at national chains and retail brands. Testimonials reference partnerships spanning 3 to 15 years, with clients citing support for limited-time offers, core ingredients, and new product launches.

The company emphasizes integrity, curiosity, and partnership as core values. It positions itself as "small enough to care, big enough to execute," highlighting trust, transparency, and results. Illes Foods aims to be an extension of its partners' teams, prioritizing relationship-building and shared growth.
